description: This file defines the FooTable.Editing component, which adds editing capabilities (edit, delete, view, add) to a FooTable instance, including UI creation, event handling, and configuration.

classes.name: F.Editing
classes.description: A component extending FooTable.Component that manages row editing, including UI controls and event handling for editing, deleting, viewing, and adding rows.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the editing component, setting up configuration options and callbacks based on the parent table.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies configuration options before UI creation, raising 'preinit.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the editing UI, raising 'init.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the editing UI and cleans up event handlers, raising 'destroy.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the editing UI elements, including buttons and event handlers.

methods.name: $buttonShow
methods.description: Returns HTML for the show button.

methods.name: $buttonHide
methods.description: Returns HTML for the hide button.

methods.name: $buttonAdd
methods.description: Returns HTML for the add button.

methods.name: $buttonEdit
methods.description: Returns HTML for the edit button.

methods.name: $buttonDelete
methods.description: Returns HTML for the delete button.

methods.name: $buttonView
methods.description: Returns HTML for the view button.

methods.name: $rowButtons
methods.description: Creates a button group for row action buttons.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Adjusts the UI layout, such as colspan.

methods.name: _onEditClick
methods.description: Handles click on edit button, raising 'edit.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: _onDeleteClick
methods.description: Handles click on delete button, raising 'delete.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: _onViewClick
methods.description: Handles click on view button, raising 'view.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: _onAddClick
methods.description: Handles click on add button, raising 'add.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: _onShowClick
methods.description: Handles click on show button, raising 'show.ft.editing' event.

methods.name: _onHideClick
methods.description: Handles click on hide button, raising 'hide.ft.editing' event.
